newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian OTC market rises in week Aug 11-14.
newsitem.headline: Croatian OTC market rises in week Aug 11-14.

text.p: The Croatian over-the-counter (OTC) market continued to rise in the shorter week to August 14, defying a bearish trend on the central bourse, the Varazdin Securities Market reported on Monday.
Its VIN index of seven leading stocks closed at 10,022 points, 0.93 percent firmer on a weekly basis, as ten stocks rose against eight that fell.
Volume shrank to 15,585 from 17,930 units and turnover to 5.5 from 6.4 million kuna. The market was closed on Friday due to a religious holiday.
Hotelier Arenaturist, jumping 20.87 percent to 139 kuna on volume of 1,969 shares, led gainers. It closed last week at 130 kuna on the central bourse in Zagreb on a much smaller volume.
Food processor Podravka, with 3,046 shares sold, was the most active issue. It lost 4.91 percent to end at 271 kuna, compared to 262 kuna on the Zagreb Stock Exchange.
Croatian subsidiary of Sweden's Ericsson -- Ericsson Nikola Tesla -- selling 2,176 units for a turnover of 1.38 million kuna, accounted for 25 percent of the total.
It also dipped 2.83 percent to 617 kuna, reversing steady gains of the past few weeks. The electronic manufacturer is not traded on the central bourse.
